articles.title: Houthis accuse Saudi Arabia of strikes that killed 3 including a child, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Houthi-run health authorities say separate strikes in areas of Yemen controlled by the Iran-backed rebels killed three people, including a child. The Houthis on Monday blamed Saudi Arabia, which did not immediately comment. Iran says three oil tankers caught fire Monday after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz. Separately, a British naval security agency said Monday an unknown projectile struck a tanker attempted to pass through the strait. A human rights group says Saudi Arabia has executed two people, including an activist. And Jordan on Monday banned Telegram because of national security concerns.

articles.title: Can Iraq PM rein in Kataib Hezbollah without triggering armed conflict?
articles.description: AMMAN — More than 40 days after the US-led coalition's withdrawal from Iraq, Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi’s government may be inching closer to armed conflict with Iran-backed factions in the country, including the one widely known as the most secretive and powerful: Kataib Hezbollah.
